يجب أن تتجنب الردود الموجهة للعميل كشف تفاصيل ملف جهة العمل. الصيغة المعتمدة: الراتب قيد التحقق التشغيلي والبنك ينسق مع جهة العمل.

demoPersonas.script: Customer 11880 Maya Al-Khatib wants an 18,000 JOD debt consolidation loan. Her monthly salary is 1,350 JOD, she has late payments, high card utilization, and a 67% debt-to-income ratio. Please assess the loan request.

demoPersonas.title: Missing Document

customerProfile.name: Yazan Saleh
customerProfile.creditHistorySummary: Good credit history with no defaults, but only 8 months of salary history with the bank.

conflict.description: Customer uploaded bank statements and ID, but official salary certificate is missing.

demoPersonas.expectedSystemBehavior: Ask customer to upload missing salary certificate before final decision.
demoPersonas.script: Customer 22017 Yazan Saleh is asking for a 14,500 JOD car loan. He uploaded his bank statements and national ID, but the official salary certificate is missing. Can the bank check eligibility?

customerProfile.name: Leen Nasser

request.purpose: Urgent supplier payment to new overseas beneficiary
